RENTAL CONTRACT – FICTIONAL SAMPLE

Apartment: 3-room, 95 sqm, Munich city center
Rent: 650 EUR all-inclusive (far below market value)

The landlord is abroad and cannot show the apartment.
Keys handed over only after payment.

Pay in advance:
- Deposit: 1,950 EUR
- First rent: 650 EUR
- "Reservation fee": 300 EUR

Payment by transfer to an account in a third country.
Viewing only possible after payment received.

Landlord: "Dr. Michael Berger" (email only)
